title: Thanksgiving Dinner Costs More in 2026
description: The American Farm Bureau's 2026 survey puts a classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 at $58.63, up about 6% from $55.18 in 2025 (under $6 per person), still below the 2022 record of $64.05. Educational only, not financial advice. #thanksgiving #personalfinance #shorts

title: A $5 Class Built Ben & Jerry's
description: Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield learned ice cream making from a $5 Penn State correspondence course, then opened in a renovated Burlington, Vermont gas station in 1978 with $12,000. Unilever bought the company for $326 million in 2000. #benandjerrys #entrepreneur #shorts
